messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: kv-cache slot contention detected in prod-east. Metric: kv.p95 and kv.p99 spiked > SLO. Incident ID: INC-2026-445. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-slot-contention

devon: I'm on pager. seeing p95 jump from ~120ms -> 1.1s, p99 ~3.4s. Streaming stalls reported (clients stuck waiting on decode). Dashboard: https://dash/kv/prod-east/shards

cory: Which tenants hit hardest? any customer-facing errors?

devon: Top tenants by RPS contributing to pressure: scalecorp-prod, retail-alpha. ScaleCorp streaming connect failures ~12% in the last 10m per logs. Prefill ops >> decode ops (2.5x) on several shards, causing eviction churn and decode wait.

maria: Logs show slab fragmentation + eviction bursts around the same windows. snippet: `evict_batch=512 slab_free=0 prefill_ops=1342 decode_ops=520 evict_ms=78`

lina: Could be prefill vs decode imbalance — prefill threads filling KV faster than decode drains, leading to hot-slot eviction loops. Any quick mitigations we can try?

devon: Trying a throttle on aggressive prefill on affected shards (6-9) now: `/ops throttler set prefill.shard=8 limit=12` — applying to 6..9 in sequence.

ops-bot: Command accepted: throttler job queued. See job ID: job-8721.

devon: After throttle on shard 8 p95 dropped to ~320ms on that shard, overall p95 down ~30% but still elevated on shards 6 and 7.

maria: Also pushed a soft eviction smoothing change to reduce batch evictions: `/cfg set kv.eviction.smooth=true window_ms=500` — this should reduce oscillation.

cory: Customer impact note: ScaleCorp CS reported degraded UX for long chat sessions and streaming disconnects. They're on a paid SLA — please keep updates coming, cc @solutions-eng.

lina: We can also route heavy tenants temporarily to burst pool. Plan: add routing rule to move 10-20% of ScaleCorp traffic to `dedicated-burst-2` using the routing API. Command: `curl -XPOST https://routing/api -d '{"tenant":"scalecorp-prod","pct":10,"pool":"dedicated-burst-2"}'`

devon: Implemented 10% reroute for scalecorp, and we also rolled a reduced model variant fallback for that traffic to reduce decode cost (`model=rw-small-q4`). Early signal: lower token decode time per request.

maria: Enabled backlog limiter for kv-prefill: `/ops kv:set backlog_limit=200` — should cap outstanding prefill inflight and prevent full slab thrash.

devon: Confirming: we've throttled prefill on shards 6-9, enabled eviction smoothing, set backlog_limit=200, and rerouted 10% scalecorp traffic + fallback model. Immediate customer-facing failures dropped to ~3% for scalecorp.

sre-rotation: Copying — good progress. Next steps for overnight: monitor p95/p99 per-shard, watch streaming tail latency and backpressure metrics, and be ready to fully disable prefill for scalecorp if errors climb.

cory: Please add incident tracker note: actions taken + mitigation steps and contact points. Link to tracker: https://inc-tracker/INC-2026-445. Also tag postmortem owner.

devon: Adding handoff details to the incident: throttled prefill (shards 6-9), eviction smoothing enabled, backlog limiter set, 10% reroute to dedicated-burst-2, fallback model deployed to rerouted traffic. If p99 remains >3s after 30m, escalate to runtime team for a hotfix to prefill/decode balancing.

maria: For the postmortem we need: 1) prefill/decode ratio metric per shard, 2) slab fragmentation metric, 3) eviction-burst counter, and 4) tenant-level prefill limits.

lina: Agreed. Also add an alert for `kv.prefill.decode.ratio > 2` per shard to detect this earlier.

cory: Handoff to @sre-rotation at 08:00 UTC. Oncall please keep updates in this thread and ping me for customer comms. :thumbsup:

sre-rotation: Acked. I'll watch p99 across shards, keep the throttles in place overnight, and run a canary tomorrow for the prefill-decode balancing patch. Updating incident tracker now.

devon: One more note — we saw a particular host (prod-east-srv-12) with very low slab_free and high evict_rate. I've isolated it and requested ops to bump slab allocation + reboot the process if it doesn't stabilize in 10m.

maria: host note logged: `prod-east-srv-12 slab_free=0 evict_rate=980/s`

cory: Thanks everyone. Good mitigations so far. We'll follow up with a detailed postmortem and remediation plan (config changes + alerting + runtime patch).
